core_meaning.primary_meaning: Rabia is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Spring”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rabia corresponds to the Arabic form رَبِيعَة (Arabic root ر ب ع (r-b-ʿ); رَبِيعَة (Rabīʿa)). Its core sense is rabia; spring (feminine). Rabia is Arabic رَبِيعَة (Rabīʿa) 'spring', from the root ر ب ع (r-b-ʿ). The source gloss 'Passionate lover' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: ربیعه
persian.long_meaning: Rabia (ربیعه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن ربیعه، بهار است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
